The '''Hosk Arena''' was a stadium on [[Hosk Station/Legends|Hosk Station]] where [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Death/Legends|death]] matches took place. [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] was forced to fight there after the Hosk Arena promoters mistook him for wanted [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] [[C-3PX]].
